# Class: `FramePanel`

Combines one frame's label, view, image, and image-edit overlays.

[Module](API-Module-icescopy-viewer.md) · [Source](../src/icescopy_viewer.py#L215) · [API index](API-Reference.md)

**Bases:** `QWidget`.

A missing pixmap clears the neighboring image and hides its overlays. The label distinguishes unavailable edge frames from neighbors awaiting a completed video seek. `clear()` owns reference-scene cleanup; current-scene contents remain the main window's responsibility.
